name: dh-enhanced-style-plates
look: Documentary sports photography, monochrome. Real athletic effort in a real place. Composition top-weighted: the figure occupies the upper two thirds, the lower third falls into deep unlit shadow and plain surface with no detail. Cinestill 35mm grain and halation. Nothing tack-sharp.

jobs.scene: A man in his late thirties in a plain dark athletic crop top and shorts mid-stride on a wet outdoor running track at dawn, shot from the side during a lateral camera pan. Ordinary, unglamorous, effortful. No gym logos, no branding anywhere.

A woman in her late thirties in a plain dark athletic crop top finishing a low plank on a chalk-dusted gym floor, seen from a low side angle during a lateral camera pan. Bare industrial windows behind. No logos anywhere.
A man in his forties walking fast up a concrete stairwell carrying a gym bag, shot from behind and below during an upward camera pan. Hard daylight from a window above. Ordinary building, no signage.
